exposure: Gestational age: Late preterm vs term
outcome: Percentage time spent at SpO2 >90% and ⩽90%
cohort: Healthy late-preterm (35 to 36 weeks gestation) and term infants within 12 to 48 hours of birth, excluding infants with cardiorespiratory symptoms or need for cardiorespiratory support at birth
finding: Healthy late-preterm and term infants spent significant time at SpO2 ⩽90% over a 6-hour monitoring period.
mod_finding: Time at SpO2 >90% was not significantly different between vaginal births and cesarean births.
